guitar.notes: Dave Brock is Hawkwind's longtime guitarist/leader; no single iconic documented model.

tone.target: psychedelic space-rock fuzz with roomy modulation
tone.profile: psychedelic space-rock fuzz with roomy modulation
tone.summary: A fuzzy signal chain utilizing Red Haze for massive sustain, followed by a UK 45 amp model, enhanced with Chorus and Room reverb to capture the expansive, psychedelic sound of Hawkwind.

rig.name: Hawkwind - Space Is Deep - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise from heavy fuzz and modulation.
Provide initial grit and boost for the fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used as a general tone shaper/boost, simulating an early overdrive needed before heavy fuzz.

blocks.purpose: Generate massive, sustained psychedelic fuzz and sustain.
Optional filter sweep for rhythmic accents (kept optional per verdict).
blocks.gap: The V-Wah is a general purpose wah; the verdict stated it was optional.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British 'Hiwatt-ish' sound and natural breakup.
blocks.gap: The AC30 TB is chosen for its vintage, open tone, fitting the psychedelic rock aesthetic better than a pure Marshall model.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet voicing suitable for fuzz and vintage tones.
Create the required 'phaser/chorus swirl' and psychedelic movement.
Add the required 'roomy modulation' and expansive space for psychedelic sound.
Included for potential dotted-eighth delay effect (optional/subtle).
blocks.gap: The verdict suggested dropping heavy delay wash, so this is kept optional and subtle.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism to better capture the vintage, open sound required for psychedelic space-rock.

proposals.reason: Improve the natural, open voicing needed for psychedelic rock fuzz.
